title: Prove the three-target support-transfer boundary
body:
## Summary

```diff
+ three marked targets and one reader that varies inside an indicator
+ an exact four-term factorization over every characteristic other than two
+ no termwise support-shrinking completion over any characteristic-two field
+ complete literal one-port reader-switch census: best bill 20 versus 16
```

The four-port proof gives an actual support-transfer obstruction beyond PR3505’s sufficient full-matroid criterion and PR3506’s two-target non-Fano transfer. It allows arbitrary new coefficients and support deletion. PR3475’s target-span reader hypothesis is explicitly left; exact predecessor heads, proof hashes and credit are preserved.

This is a scoped method-boundary result. All 52,080 literal cases lose; the minimum excess is 4, with charges [4,4,4,8]. Appending untouched indicators gives 228 versus 224. No cheaper decoder, native program, supplier, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the non-Fano two-target result leaves the arbitrary-target selective-transfer question unresolved. **After:** a self-contained counterexample forces three pair-span requests and one incompatible triangle request in every characteristic-two field.
- Two separate implementations agree on every one of 52,080 actual rectangular Gram bills, the full histogram and ordered stream digest. The selected literal operator passes all 12,544 entries with query/reader ranks (3,4).
- The primary exhausts 1/243/16,807 normalized GF2/GF4/GF8 cases. The separate checker exhausts 4,096 raw GF2 arrays including support deletion, plus all 243 normalized GF4 cases. The quantified field claim comes from the written proof.
- Four actual optimized CLI faults reject; restored positive replay and two exclusive-copy/symlink controls pass. CPython 3.12 registered replay, warnings-as-errors, strict Ruff/formatting and exact diff/proof review pass. No check relies on Python assertions.
- At commit `5891d1762ef35357eba1ea6177b3418d8c9b867e`, the actual committed-byte/source-history gate passes all 12 package/input files. All three committed Git-free export commands pass; all 13 exported files and all source/runtime identities remain unchanged. Comparison-only proofs are separate from canonical ancestry and runtime pins.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-triple-transfer-obstruction
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p112-triple-transfer-obstruction --check-source-history
```

README.md gives direct isolated/optimized commands and Git-free export reproduction. Use an existing private TMPDIR. No full selected cold replay, Lean, Docker, independent human or formal proof-kernel review is claimed. General readers and all native/physical/compiler/consumer obligations remain open.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Adds eleven scoped research files. Frozen predecessor bytes, canonical live inputs, shared tooling and the selected result remain unchanged.
